_comment: SPEC 9.2: per-application team leader, notified when a bug is routed to a sprint at High or escalated at Highest. Copy to config/leaders.json (gitignored) and fill in. `slack` is a Slack user ID (Profile -> More -> Copy member ID). `jira` is an accountId - `npm run discover` prints the service account's, and /rest/api/3/user/search?query=<email> gives anyone else's. `default` is used for any application not listed. The keys must match the `app:` label BugBot writes, which is the application name slugified - see slugify() in src/types.ts.
